Our Dera

Apni mitti.
Apna sukoon.

Dera Kharala Da is a place rooted in the everyday beauty of rural Punjab — open courtyards, a traditional veranda, fields on the horizon and the feeling of being at home.

“Jithe mitti di khushboo, othe dil da sukoon.”
A place to gather · relax · remember

The experience

More than a farmhouse.

The best part of a dera is not what is built around you — it is the people, the conversations, the chai, the open air and the memories made there.
